claim: Task states represent a unit of work that another AWS service performs, such as calling another AWS service or API. You can also use workers that run outside of Step Functions (activities) to perform tasks.

evidence.quote: Task states represent a unit of work that another AWS service performs, such as calling another AWS service or API.
(Note: You can also use workers that run outside of Step Functions to perform tasks. For more info, see [Activities](concepts-activities.md).)
